patch.value: GH-1614: keep typed SDK data literal across CLI sentinel inputs

GitHub https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1614 reports typed PmClient fields consuming CLI sentinels. A sandboxed current-source Node24 probe with closed stdin reproduces description '-' becoming empty and assignee 'none' being removed. Typed integrations can silently rewrite provider payloads. Audit create/update/append and separate literal typed input from explicit CLI stdin, file and clear transport syntax, retaining documented unset APIs and CLI compatibility.
Typed SDK string data round-trips sentinel spellings without implicit stdin/file reads; explicit unset remains typed and CLI sentinel behavior retains focused conformance evidence.
